author: Male1994
quote: I’m lost for words, truly. This feels like a mobile game, or a Nintendo game. I never thought GTA would ever look like this. The frame rate, dropping BELOW 30 fps in scenarios, the character “Jason” being so uninteresting, Lucia bossing him around like a dog, the story being so boring etc etc… You get the point. I wish I could refund. But I got scammed, unfortunately. And so did everyone else buying this game, in my honest opinion. If you defend this game, for whatever reason. You’re weird. There is no reason to defend this game. This is a terrible game, guys.
